items.text: LA Chargers (final report, Sat Nov 14, preliminary for MNF): OUT - G Branson Taylor (ankle), CB Isas Waxter (ankle), S Kendall Williamson (calf). DOUBTFUL - WR Brenen Thompson (hamstring). QUESTIONABLE - WR Ladd McConkey (back, DNP all week), G Kayode Awosika (fibula), DL Justin Eboigbe (ankle), TE David Njoku, LB Denzel Perryman and OL Trey Pipkins III (all need IR activation). Justin Herbert (left finger) not designated; starts.
items.source: Yahoo Sports (Chargers list Ladd McConkey as questionable for Monday night, Nov 14)

items.text: Baltimore (Fri practice report): no active-roster player missed practice Thu or Fri. Limited Fri - S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee); Full - S Kyle Hamilton (hip), WR Rashod Bateman (calf), CB Nate Wiggins (illness), G Olaivavega Ioane. IR - QB Lamar Jackson (thumb, 6-10 weeks), QB Tyler Huntley. Jacoby Brissett (acquired from ARI) starts.
